name: boxcode-agent
description: Chat with boxcode, driven over its ACP stdio interface.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Chat stays available in Restricted Mode. boxcode will not read, write, or run commands until this folder is trusted.

chatParticipants.name: boxcode
chatParticipants.description: Ask boxcode to read, write, and run things in this workspace.

commands.name: provider
commands.description: Pick a provider, model, and API key (same as the boxcode CLI /provider flow).

commands.name: model
commands.description: Switch model for the current provider without changing the API key.

commands.title: boxcode: Change Provider / Model / API Key

boxcode.path.markdownDescription: Path to the `boxcode` CLI binary, if it isn't on the PATH this app was launched with. Leave empty to resolve `boxcode` off PATH, then `~/.local/bin`, `/usr/local/bin`, `~/.cargo/bin`, and `~/.boxcode/bin` (the locations `install.sh` actually writes to, which a Finder-launched app's PATH often misses).

boxcode.provider.markdownDescription: LLM provider registry id (e.g. `deepseek`), or empty for a custom endpoint. Prefer **Sign In to boxcode.sh** (Accounts / profile menu), chat `/provider`, or [Change Provider / Model / API Key](command:boxcode.changeProvider).

boxcode.endpoint.markdownDescription: Base URL for boxcode's OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint (e.g. `https://api.deepseek.com` or `https://llm.boxcode.sh/v1`). Set automatically by Sign In / `/provider`; leave empty to use `~/.boxcode/config.toml` from the CLI when no IDE override is stored.

boxcode.model.markdownDescription: Model name for the configured provider/endpoint. Use chat `/model` to pick from the provider's list, `/provider` to change provider + model + key, or [Change Provider / Model / API Key](command:boxcode.changeProvider).

boxcode.apiKey.markdownDescription: API keys are stored in the OS secure store (never in `settings.json`). Prefer [Sign In to boxcode.sh](command:boxcode.signIn), [Set API Key](command:boxcode.setApiKey), or [Change Provider / Model / API Key](command:boxcode.changeProvider).

boxcode.costPerMillionTokens.markdownDescription: Blended USD price per million tokens, used for the `~$` estimate in the chat usage footnote. Defaults to a blended DeepSeek input+output estimate; set to 0 to show token totals only. The authoritative per-model figure should come from boxcode itself (see `docs/BACKLOG.md`, cost/usage meter).
